title: Neural Disjunctive Normal Forms for Learning Exact Rank Filters
abstract: arXiv:2610.32203v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gradient-based learning of morphological operators is hindered by locally sparse derivatives with respect to the structuring elements. We develop a method for learning rank filters that retains exact operator evaluation while distributing the derivatives across the window. Using threshold decomposition, we construct a neural disjunctive normal form representation and establish a sufficient condition for exactness with integer-valued images and structuring elements. We then derive a smooth surrogate from the unique root of a smooth threshold equation. Implicit differentiation gives closed-form derivatives with normalised local weights, whose distribution is controlled by a smoothing parameter. These derivatives are used in a straight-through procedure: the forward pass evaluates the exact rank filter, while the backward pass uses the surrogate. translated_title: 用于学习精确秩滤波器的神经析取范式
translated_abstract: 基于梯度的形态学算子学习因结构元素的局部稀疏导数而受到阻碍。我们开发了一种学习秩滤波器的方法，该方法在保留精确算子求值的同时，将导数分布在整个窗口上。利用阈值分解，我们构建了一种神经析取范式表示，并建立了针对整数值图像和结构元素的精确性充分条件。随后，我们从平滑阈值方程的唯一根导出一个平滑替代函数。隐式微分给出了具有归一化局部权重的闭式导数，其分布由平滑参数控制。这些导数被用于直通式（straight-through）过程：前向传播计算精确的秩滤波器，而后向传播使用平滑替代函数。对于固定秩，该过程可以学习任意秩滤波器的实值结构元素……
tldr: 本文提出基于阈值分解的神经析取范式来学习精确秩滤波器，通过前向传播精确求值、后向传播使用平滑替代导数的直通式方法，解决了形态学算子梯度学习中导数稀疏的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes neural disjunctive normal forms based on threshold decomposition for learning exact rank filters, solving the sparse derivative problem in gradient-based learning of morphological operators through a straight-through method with exact forward evaluation and smooth surrogate backward derivatives.
